note: Mark Twain National Forest campground and picnic area in oak and cedar forest at the equestrian trailhead of the Cedar Creek Trail, southwest of Fulton. It serves campers with or without horses; each site has a hitching post. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: FS page lists 8 single sites, RV length 30 ft, no hookups, potable water, vault toilets, $15/night, 50% Senior/Access discount, open Apr 15-Dec 1 2026. Season changed 04-01..12-31 (derived, 'Approximate') -> 04-15..12-01 manual; other groups confirmed and written manual. No recreation.gov listing (booking left as stored). Pin is on the entrance road junction; FS point on the loop ~95 m N. Add district phone. Not a horse-only camp.
flags: SEASON changed: stored derived 04-01..12-31 'Approximate: Open April to December.' -> 04-15..12-01 per the FS page ('Open April 15 to December 1, 2026'). The page dates the season to 2026; it is the posted recurring pattern as far as the page shows.

HORSE CAMP check: page 'a campground and picnic area, is located at the equestrian trailhead of the 36-mile Cedar Creek Trail... serves recreationists with or without horses'; 'Hitching posts are at each site for equestrian use.' Not horse-only; a general campground at a horse trailhead, so it stays. 'No overnight camping in day use areas at any time of year' (the trailhead/day-use lot is separate from the 8 sites).
FIT: 'RV Length: 30' in length' - a 23-ft rig fits. Access on county roads (CR 356 / CR 361, 'turn left to go south for 1 mile'); no 4WD, ford or gravel warning on the page.

BOOKING: no recreation.gov listing found (by name, and none within 15 mi of the pin); the FS page names no reservation channel and gives only the $15 fee. Stored booking {reservable:false, fcfs:'always'} (derived from old note prose) left as is - consistent with what the page shows but not stated outright.
GROUP SITE: the old note said 'plus a group site'; the FS page lists only 'Sites: 8 single' and says nothing of a group site, so it was dropped from the note.

PIN: stored 38.7834,-92.1252 sits on the entrance road where it meets the county road at the south end. The FS page's point 38.784231,-92.125542 (~95 m N) is inside the campground loop on imagery. Suggest moving the pin to 38.7842,-92.1255.
PHONE (add): Houston/Rolla/Cedar Creek Ranger District '417-967-4194' (the FS page's office contact). Entry has no phone.
Waterfront not waterfront kept: forest loop, no water in view on imagery.
